summary: Fixed surfaceCluster verdict path to auto-resolve as DISTINCT instead of escalating to user via AMBIGUOUS_INTENT guidance. Three changes: (1) routes/judge.js: replaced the non-settled surfaceCluster path with markClusterDistinct + clearPendingDup + stamped distinct verdict — notes no longer get stuck in pendingDup limbo; (2) lib/judge.js: added resolveAmbiguousClusterGuidance() that drains existing open AMBIGUOUS_INTENT dup-cluster guidance by marking them distinct and resolving them; (3) routes/session.js: called resolveAmbiguousClusterGuidance on every GET /guidance tick to drain stale guidance on next poll. Committed as 6b810e8 on orch/attempt/followup-surfacecluster-auto-distinct.
